design: Battery backpack V2 rev B ('sits down'), printable frame and cap, both Orange. The 2S 3000 mAh pack (74 x 34 x 20 envelope) stands upright, leads up, 6.3 mm right of centre in a column of the frame; the lower tier ends at z -46 so the seated robot keeps 10 mm or more under the backpack; nothing grows behind today's x -75.55, above z 43 or wider than |y| 32.05. The 16 mm LED button sits in the cap's upper left beside the pack; the Pololu 2813 is taped to the left wing's outer wall, the DFR1202 to the battery column's left rib on the left wing, the XIAO SAMD21 high on the right wing wall with its USB-C behind a window in the cap. Two fixed L contact pads lie flush under the floor at y +-9; the cap is a back plate over both tiers, held by two M2 x 8 (high) into frame bosses and two M2 x 6 (low) into columns in the wings beside the battery column; two cap pins locate the pad tabs. The boards, the battery, the diode and the pads go in from the open back after the frame is on the robot, and nothing fixed stands in their paths. The frame screws onto the OpenRB pack posts with the four M2 x 6 as today. No snaps, hooks, flexures or latches.

approved.history: 2026-11-20 02:15: Shawn asked for a complete power plan and a redesigned backpack, with the cart filled only when the design is complete. 03:29 he asked whether rev A (lower tier to z -55) affects sitting down; it did (1.7 mm off the floor seated), so the concept was reworked to rev B (bottom z -46, 10.9 mm seated; ../battery-v2-concept-20261119/concept-sheet.png). 05:46 he approved rev B with '可以，加购物车'. This CAD follows that concept; the changes the CAD stage had to make (lower-tier left wall 1.8 mm further out for the driver corridor, front wall cut round the shell lips, top stops as pillars and cap tabs, high-left cap screw at z 19; low cap screws moved off the battery path into the wings, pads on cap pins, after the guide gate found the rev B1 battery path blocked) are in build_v2.py's docstring and features.json.
